component.name: VideoItemComponent
component.script:
sub init() m.thumbnail = m.top.findNode("thumbnail") m.fallbackIcon = m.top.findNode("fallbackIcon") m.titleLabel = m.top.findNode("titleLabel") m.descLabel = m.top.findNode("descLabel") m.top.observeField("itemContent", "onContentChanged") end sub
sub onContentChanged() content = m.top.itemContent if content = invalid then return
m.titleLabel.text = content.title
if content.description <> invalid and content.description <> "" m.descLabel.text = content.description else m.descLabel.text = content.url end if
' Handle thumbnail or show local fallback icon if content.HDPosterUrl <> invalid and content.HDPosterUrl <> "" m.thumbnail.uri = content.HDPosterUrl m.thumbnail.visible = true m.fallbackIcon.visible = false else m.thumbnail.visible = false m.fallbackIcon.visible = true end if end sub
